title: Signed frame of protocol 1
description: Every message between processes is one frame. The signature covers the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the frame without its signature, after the domain prefix universal-agents/message-frame/v1 and a newline. The issuer's host certificate and agent session are looked up in the receiver's trust store. The body is checked against the schema its kind names in the registry.

protocol.description: The protocol label and minor version.

subject.description: The exact NATS delivery subject. Work, requests and events use ua.v1.<audience team>.<sender slot>.<address>, where the sender slot is the issuer's runtime, or x-<issuer installation> for a frame from another installation. Operation replies use _INBOX.<audience.runtime>.<inbox token(s)> and name their request in causation_id.

causation_id.description: The message that caused this one.

body_digest.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the body.
